mechanisms.name: dendrite arm spacing refinement by increased cooling rate

evidence.quote: dendritic arm spacing decreases with the interval time between layers due to higher cooling rate driving to finer microstructure

mechanisms.name: surface corrosion reduction by reduced high-temperature exposure

evidence.quote: This surface corrosion in linked with the c ooling rate of the wall, as the time be tween layers increases the time of each layer at high temperature (without the protection of the claddi ng head) is reduced, decreasing the appearance of surface corrosion.
